description: Residential proxy providers that meet a buyer’s requirements (SOCKS5, city/ZIP/ASN targeting, PayPal or crypto, no ID check, traffic that never expires, a price cap, a sourcing check level, a smallest first purchase, a session length), with each one’s checkout price for 1, 10 or 100 GB. Regular prices come first, lowest first; first-purchase offers and upper bounds follow, flagged. Every result links to its proxyrange.com page and says when its prices were checked.

basketGb.description: Purchase size to price, in GB bought at once: 1, 10 (default) or 100

limit.description: At most this many results (default 10, up to 30)

maxMinimumPurchaseUsd.description: Only providers whose smallest first purchase is at most this many US dollars

maxPriceUsd.description: Only providers whose checkout price for that basket is at most this many US dollars

minStickyMinutes.description: Only providers that keep one IP for at least this many minutes

needs.description: Requirements every result must meet: socks5; state, city, zip or asn (finest targeting); paypal or crypto (payment); no-id (no ID check to sign up and buy); no-expiry (unused traffic never expires)

sourcing.description: Only providers whose sourcing check is one of these (not-reviewed: no check yet)

name: find_providers

attribution.description: How to credit the data when you show it

matched.description: How many providers meet every requirement

medianUsd.description: The market median of regular checkout prices for this basket

page.description: Its page on proxyrange.com: cite this

label.description: Why the price isn’t regular, when it isn’t

note.description: The plan the price comes from

regular.description: false for a first-purchase offer, a coupon price or an upper bound: never call it the price

usd.description: Checkout price in US dollars, before tax

updated.description: The newest date any fact in the data was checked (YYYY-MM-DD)

title: Find residential proxy providers
